cluster.notes: Five qualitative clusters built from headlines/summaries: Iran-Hormuz strikes, AI markets rout, Bolton plea, Anthropic/OpenAI release, EU digital-tax tariff.

chosen.cluster: US strikes Iran after Tehran drone attack on cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz; Iran retaliates against US-linked targets
Oracle posts worst week since 2001 dot-com bust as AI financing fears spread; Grantham calls market most expensive in U.S. history
Former Trump national-security adviser John Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified documents
Trump administration allows limited release of Anthropic's Mythos model to vetted customers and OpenAI delays public rollout of GPT-5.6 amid cybersecurity review
Trump threatens 100 percent tariffs on countries that impose digital services taxes on U.S. tech firms; EU pushes back

select.notes: Original slot 3 (VW 100k layoffs) was dropped at the research stage: no body-tier publisher (Reuters/Axios/Ars/DW/AP) returned a fetchable article URL outside Google News JS-redirected pages, leaving only a single CNBC body source — below the 2-outlet hard minimum. Bolton guilty plea (Politics) was promoted to slot 3 from the next-ranked queue with clean BBC + CNBC body sources.

sources_failed_egress: news.google.com (article body — requires JS to follow redirect)

illustrate.notes: All 5 OpenAI gpt-image-2 calls failed with http.client.IncompleteRead — the proxy is truncating image-generation responses (~1.3–1.4 MB read before connection closed). Non-fatal per pipeline contract; all 5 articles ship with has_illustration: false and render text-only.

errors.detail: OpenAI gpt-image-2 image bytes truncated by proxy in all 5 attempts (~1.3 MB read of expected ~1.7-2.0 MB). illustrate.py one-retry-on-non-2xx logic did not trigger because responses had 2xx status before connection cut. Articles published with has_illustration: false.
